description: Authored Kotoba A1 scope: stable learning IDs, reviewed overlapping topics, and an explicit bounded denominator. CEFR/JF alignment is based on communicative tasks, never an official word quota.

completion.label: Kotoba A1 foundation
completion.explanation: Core vocabulary practice plus practical Can-do self-checks. Three spaced practice occasions are a progress signal, not proof of recall or an official CEFR result.

topics.title: Greetings & pleasantries
topics.description: Say hello, thank someone, apologize, say goodbye, and use everyday polite phrases.

topics.title: Family & people
topics.description: Describe the people in your life and share a little about yourself.

topics.title: Food & eating out
topics.description: Meals, preferences, menus, and ordering something you enjoy.

topics.title: Home & surroundings
topics.description: Rooms, belongings, and welcoming someone into your home.

topics.title: Daily life & plans
topics.description: Your day, the time, and making simple plans together.

topics.title: School & learning
topics.description: Classroom language, reading, writing, and asking for help.

topics.title: Work & introductions
topics.description: Your job, working hours, and everyday workplace greetings.

topics.title: Around town & travel
topics.description: Places, transport, directions, and simple travel experiences.

topics.title: Shopping & clothes
topics.description: Find things you need and ask about prices, colors, and sizes.

topics.title: Hobbies & time off
topics.description: Share interests, arrange an outing, and talk about a day off.

topics.title: Culture & events
topics.description: Explore festivals, familiar cultural activities, and things to see.

topics.title: Everyday objects
topics.description: Books, household items, useful belongings, and where to find them.

milestones.title: Meet someone
milestones.description: Exchange greetings and introduce yourself simply.
milestones.task: Greet someone, give your name, respond politely, and say goodbye.
milestones.evidenceNote: Self-assessment after trying the task. Related sentence practice prepares vocabulary; it does not assess this complete communicative skill.

milestones.title: Ask for help
milestones.task: Ask someone to repeat slowly, then follow their short instruction.

milestones.title: Introduce your family
